LESSON: READING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.4 Reading for Comprehension (2 sessions) • Pronunciation • Comprehensi
Topic 2.6: Reading for Information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Information, part of Reading 2.4 Reading for Comprehension (2 sessions) • Pronunciation • Comprehensi in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can you paraphrase a long text without losing out on key ideas?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. team up with peers to identify locations

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. team up with peers to identify locations

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: Team building is promoted as the learner engages actively with peers to match

vocabulary to its meaning.

• Self-efficacy: The learner develops a self-driven attitude to learn when they read level-appropriate text independently

during free time.

Unity: This is nurtured as the learner cooperates with peers to summarise key ideas from a written text.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

for healthy eating to avoid some diseases.

Link to other Learning Areas:
